# Persisted data regression fixtures

These fixtures are append-only. Never edit or delete an existing file to make a
test pass. When the stored shape changes, add a new fixture and a migration that
keeps existing data readable.

Captured on 2026-11-13 with a temporary Bun script (removed after capture):

- `trip-state.v2.*.json`: actual `initialState` / `reduce` outputs across every
  stage, including destination clarification and the Japan destination check.
  The itinerary samples use scripted model/tool inputs through `groundResults`,
  `mergeStays` and `linkStays`, following the assignments in `TurnService.run`.
- `message-metadata.*.json`: actual `render(state, copy(state.locale))` outputs
  in the `{ components, revision }` envelope written by `TurnService.saveTurn`.
  These include English and Chinese choices, forms, buttons and cards.
- `trip-state.v1.reviewing-itinerary.json`: the existing `legacy.spec.ts`
  `legacy('reviewing_itinerary')` factory executed verbatim. This is the old
  `metadata.uiFlowSnapshot` value consumed by `fromLegacySnapshot` in
  `scripts/migrate-trip-state.ts`, rather than a v2 `conversations.tripState`.

`src/trip/snapshots.spec.ts` discovers all JSON files here automatically. It reads
v2 samples through `readState`, v1 through `fromLegacySnapshot`, and historical
message components through the shared `@autix/contracts` `ComponentSchema`.
The fixtures are independent of current schemas and are never regenerated by tests.
